{
  "dataset_name": "bng_breast_w",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "mean_cytology_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of all nine cytological measurements, providing a smooth overall severity score.",
      "formula": "(Clump_Thickness + Cell_Size_Uniformity + Cell_Shape_Uniformity + Marginal_Adhesion + Single_Epi_Cell_Size + Bare_Nuclei + Bland_Chromatin + Normal_Nucleoli + Mitoses) / 9.0",
      "value_range": [0.5, 13.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth linear composite that strongly correlates with overall cellular abnormality, ideal for linear SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "uniformity_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of size and shape uniformity, two highly diagnostic correlated features.",
      "formula": "0.5 * Cell_Size_Uniformity + 0.5 * Cell_Shape_Uniformity",
      "value_range": [0.9, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures uniformity axis as a single smooth projection, reducing redundancy in the linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "nuclei_chromatin_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted average of bare nuclei and bland chromatin, both indicators of nuclear abnormality.",
      "formula": "0.5 * np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0) + 0.5 * Bland_Chromatin",
      "value_range": [0.5, 12.5],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth nuclear-severity projection complementary to uniformity axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "size_shape_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of cell size uniformity to cell shape uniformity, capturing relative abnormality direction.",
      "formula": "(Cell_Size_Uniformity + 1.0) / (Cell_Shape_Uniformity + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.1, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized scale-invariant ratio feature beneficial for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "log_mitoses",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed mitoses count to compress its skewed range into a smooth scale.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(Mitoses - 1.0, 0.0))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.6],
      "feature_family": "transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes mitoses signal so it contributes proportionally to the SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "severity_max",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Maximum value across all cytology measurements, capturing the worst single indicator.",
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(Clump_Thickness, Cell_Size_Uniformity), np.maximum(Cell_Shape_Uniformity, Marginal_Adhesion)), np.maximum(np.maximum(Single_Epi_Cell_Size, np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0)), np.maximum(Bland_Chromatin, np.maximum(Normal_Nucleoli, Mitoses))))",
      "value_range": [1.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "extremum",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a non-linear extremum signal still usable as a linear coordinate.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "severity_spread",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Range between maximum and minimum measurement across the nine features, indicating heterogeneity.",
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(Clump_Thickness, Cell_Size_Uniformity), np.maximum(Cell_Shape_Uniformity, Marginal_Adhesion)), np.maximum(np.maximum(Single_Epi_Cell_Size, np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0)), np.maximum(Bland_Chromatin, np.maximum(Normal_Nucleoli, Mitoses)))) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(Clump_Thickness, Cell_Size_Uniformity), np.minimum(Cell_Shape_Uniformity, Marginal_Adhesion)), np.minimum(np.minimum(Single_Epi_Cell_Size, np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0)), np.minimum(Bland_Chromatin, np.minimum(Normal_Nucleoli, Mitoses))))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 13.0],
      "feature_family": "dispersion",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Heterogeneity across measurements is informative and provides a smooth additional axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "high_severity_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of measurements with values above 5, a soft indicator of multiple elevated markers.",
      "formula": "np.where(Clump_Thickness > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Cell_Size_Uniformity > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Cell_Shape_Uniformity > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Marginal_Adhesion > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Single_Epi_Cell_Size > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Bare_Nuclei > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Bland_Chromatin > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Normal_Nucleoli > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Mitoses > 5, 1, 0)",
      "value_range": [0, 9],
      "feature_family": "count_threshold",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Discrete count adds a step-wise linear contribution capturing breadth of abnormality.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "adhesion_epi_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of marginal adhesion and epithelial cell size capturing combined tissue disorganization.",
      "formula": "np.sqrt(Marginal_Adhesion * Single_Epi_Cell_Size)",
      "value_range": [1.0, 13.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Square-root interaction provides a smooth, bounded interaction term linearizable for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "nuclei_to_thickness_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of bare nuclei to clump thickness, capturing relative nuclear vs structural severity.",
      "formula": "(np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0) + 1.0) / (Clump_Thickness + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.05, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized ratio supplies a scale-invariant signal complementing absolute composites.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "clinical_severity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic clinical severity score blending domain weighting: uniformity and bare nuclei carry stronger diagnostic weight than mitoses or epithelial size in standard cytology interpretation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_weighted_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes prior medical knowledge about feature importance into a smooth scalar useful for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "atypia_pattern_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of whether the pattern of measurements resembles atypical concerted elevation (multiple uniformity, nuclei, and chromatin features simultaneously elevated) versus isolated elevations, scored continuously.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_pattern",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures co-elevation pattern as a smooth probability-like score that linear SVM can weight directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
